annotations.title: Watch the total price of a product without an account (e-mail, double opt-in)

description: No account (UX-72): the person gives an e-mail and Fordeal mails them when the recommended total for `deliver_to_country` (goods + shipping, the product page's meaning) falls under `target_total` (default: today's total, i.e. any real drop by the currency's step), never twice for one price and at most once a day. Double opt-in: the address first gets only a confirmation link; nothing else is sent before the person clicks it (an agent cannot confirm for the person). Every alert has pause and cancel links that work without signing in (GET/POST /api/v1/price-watches/link). Unconfirmed watches are deleted after 7 days, confirmed ones 365 days after the confirmation. One watch per address and product, at most 20 per address; the answer is the same whether the address is known or not. Ask the person for consent before passing their e-mail. A signed-in person can use set_price_watch instead (no confirmation needed).

deliver_to_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "CZ". Optional: normally derived from the address.

email.description: The person's e-mail (they confirm it themselves).

ip_hash.description: sha-256 of the visitor's address with a daily salt (the website computes it).

locale.description: Language of the mails. Default: the country's.

target_total.description: Mail when the total falls to or under this amount, in the currency of deliver_to_country. Default: today's total.
